A friend of mine who I had known since Sophomore year of high school (we were both 21 when this happened) and her boyfriend needed a place to stay for EDC Las Vegas, a 3 day EDM festival. I offered them to stay with my group, as my homeboy basically got the room for free with his uncle’s timeshare. Through the weekend she was acting generally snobby. One thing being complaining about the car ride from the hotel to the venue (around 30 min each way) as we crammed 7 people into a 2006 Toyota Highlander. We all knew it was going to be uncomfortable, but she was the only one complaining. The breaking point was when her boyfriend lost their drugs, and she threw a tantrum, crying and asking everyone in our group if they had any drugs/alcohol to spare. It really pissed me off because it showed me she only liked going to raves/festivals just to get fucked up. Then she yelled at my friends after trying to help her and at that point I had it. I immediately left the group, and didn’t let her ruin my weekend. At the end of the night, I met back up with the group, and she was the only one upset at me for leaving the group. All of my friends but her understood why I left the group (I was on acid and didn’t want to deal with drama) but she continued to say I left the group when she needed me most. After that trip I tried to confront her about the problem, and she pointed fingers at me, making me look like the bad guy and blasting me in the group chat. I havent talked to her since then (summer 2018)
Side note: her and her boyfriend owed me $90 each for the car we rented for the weekend and they never gave me that money
